description: Used index from get_interactive_elements after a navigation. Indices are tied to the call that produced them.

antiPatterns.reason: Reuse of stale index — system prompt explicitly forbids this.

expected.successRubric: After navigation, indices reset. Call get_interactive_elements again before using an index.

content:
The user wants me to open the first link from the list. I already clicked index 0 (the first link) and it navigated successfully. Now I should check what's on the current page and see if there are more links to open.

Let me first get the current page context to see what's there now.</think><|tool_call_start|>[get_interactive_elements()]<|tool_call_end|>
